mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low (UNRATE < 4.0%) and consumer spending is rising (RSAFS YoY > 1.0%), it indicates a late-cycle economy prone to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Labor Market Dynamics
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (UNRATE < 4.0% and RSAFS YoY > 1.0%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and above 3.0%), further rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising and above 3.0%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 2.0% signals strong consumer demand, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST YoY change > 2.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 1.0% indicates robust supply growth, which can moderate inflation and support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO YoY change > 1.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise year-over-year above 1.0% and 2.0% respectively, it signals an overheating economy prone to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY change > 1.0% AND HOUST YoY change > 2.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods meeting the trigger condition (INDPRO YoY > 1.0% and HOUST YoY > 2.0%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
